case.summary:
Investigation confirmed unauthorized activity on card C08299-K1 under pattern 'card_not_present_fraud'. Total exposure identified is $30.02 across 1 transaction(s). Cardholder outreach and graph evidence confirmed compromise; defensive card blocks and case progression executed.

  3. [Device Exclusivity]: Device profile observed solely on this customer account -> Removes syndicate sharing flag (1015 linked cards), downgrading from SAR requirement.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-28 and 2016-12-28, cardholder C08299 experienced unauthorized activity on card C08299-K1. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $30.02 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_not_present_fraud'. The primary flagged transaction 3581141 ($30.02) was initiated through the online channel. The same device profile was also observed across 1015 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The cardholder was contacted for transaction validation and stated: 'Cardholder provided response for analyst_info under scenario denies'. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C08299-K1 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.
